notes: Cables: per frame set the carrier pose, latch, hinge body / display pose and camera, then entity.update() and render3D(); ground sampler = deckBase + 13.5 + 0.2 sin(0.05 x) cos(0.07 z). ribbonA/ribbonB are the 4-vertex quads (index 0,1,2,2,1,3), line the 3-point polyline, all carrier-local float32. `initial` is after the constructor. Stern ribbon: update(stern, aft) per step; positions are the 50 segment quads concatenated (root-relative, float32). Ship wake: Math.random = mulberry32(seed); `draws` counts calls so far; hashes are FNV-1a over the drawn float32 prefix; dumps every few frames.
